pkgmetadata.longdescription: River is a tiling Wayland compositor with a non-tile-friendly tiling window manager. Since 0.4.x it is written in Zig and built with the Zig build system; this ebuild seeds Zig's package cache offline from fetched sources so the sandbox stays network-free. The man pages require scdoc at build time.

use.flag: Build with XWayland support for X11 applications
